description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Specialist Product Manager
Senior Product Manager, Business Experimentation \& Optimization
  

  

Who is Mastercard?
  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting\-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test \& Learn), and data\-driven information and risk management services.
  

  

As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry\-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test \& Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test \& Learn.
  

  

Role
  

Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test \& Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi\-million\-dollar decisions.
  

  

Develop product strategy derived from user research, market trends, customer pain points, and commercial priorities.
  

  

Translate a deep understanding of our users into an actionable roadmap. Leverage user research, market research, sales/marketing expertise, and usage data to inform priorities.
  

  

Own end\-to\-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, design solutions, write requirements, support development and testing, and measure impact to inform future decisions.
  

  

Work as a part of a cross\-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with UX designers, engineers, and other product managers to improve our products.
  

  

Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
  

  

All About You
  

Can work closely with cross\-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
  

  

A quick learner with the ability to multi\-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
  

  

Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
  

  

Creative problem\-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
  

  

Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
  

  

Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application
  

  

5\+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent.
  

  

Corporate Security Responsibility
  

Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for this position must:
  

  

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

title: Senior Product Manager - Technical
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Product Manager \- Technical
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries all around the world. Our people, technology, data and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.  

  

As a company, we know that our success is driven by the skills, experience, integrity and mindset of the talent we hire. By building an inclusive, world\-class culture, our employees have once\-in\-a\-career opportunities to be a part of teams that have a greater impact on our community and our world. We invite you to join our team to find out how you too can start something priceless.
  

  

Overview  

The Senior Product Manager – Technical is responsible for managing the improvement of new and existing product features for both our consumer business and our B2B2C business. This role balances frontend and platform product management, owning UX outcomes across direct UI design and API behavior. The PMT works closely with engineering, UX/design, and cross functional partners to deliver intuitive, scalable, and on brand experiences across the Priceless ecosystem while building foundational technical, product, and business fluency.  

  

Responsibilities  

* Support delivery of end to end Priceless capabilities spanning Priceless.com frontend experiences and platform APIs used by internal teams and whitelisted B2B partners
* Treat APIs as long lived platform products while ensuring the Priceless.com website evolves as a high quality consumer experience
* Contribute to requirements across frontend features, backend services, APIs, request/response behavior, validations, error handling, and session management
* Own UX outcomes through both API behavior and direct UI design, ensuring cohesive, intuitive, and consistent experiences.
* Understand how user experiences shape across Priceless.com consumer journeys and whitelisted external B2B partner sites.
* Define and validate end to end journeys (discovery, eligibility, checkout, payment, confirmation, fulfilment) across UI and APIs.
* Ensure frontend and API decisions collectively support performance, clarity, error recovery, redirects, callbacks, session lifecycle, and third party handoffs.
* Partner closely with UX/design and engineering teams to translate journey intent into UI experiences and supporting API contracts.
* Understand consumers, developers, and B2B partners as distinct customer types and balance UX quality, partner flexibility, and platform consistency.
* Translate business, UX, and platform needs into engineering ready epics, features, and acceptance criteria.
* Participate in agile ceremonies including refinement, planning, and demos; validate outcomes against UX intent, API behavior, and business goals.
* Continuously monitor feature development at the feature level adjusting throughout implementation and post\-launch.
* Leverage AI assisted product workflows to improve effectiveness (e.g., drafting requirements, analyzing feedback and usage patterns, accelerating discovery and iteration) while applying AI responsibly with awareness of data sensitivity and accuracy.

  

All About You  

* Foundational experience or strong interest in technical product management for platforms, APIs, or digital consumer products.
* Ability to reason about UX across both frontend UI and backend APIs.
* Solid understanding of software systems, APIs, and integrations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous learning mindset.
* Experience with consumer facing websites and API driven platforms.
* BA or equivalent education
* 3\-5 years previous experience working with both product/dev and front end teams

  

Nice to Have:  

* Exposure to B2B partner integrations
* Familiarity with AI assisted product workflows
* Awareness of platform governance, security, or compliance considerations

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Overview  

We are seeking an experienced Software Release Manager to lead end\-to\-end release planning, scheduling, and orchestration across a portfolio of 7\-8 interconnected software products and platforms. This role is responsible for establishing and maintaining an integrated release calendar that balances product roadmaps, engineering capacity, testing environment availability, customer commitments, regulatory requirements, and cross\-program dependencies.
  

The ideal candidate thrives in complex enterprise environments where multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders must coordinate to successfully deliver high\-quality software releases. This individual will serve as the central point of coordination for release readiness, dependency management, environment planning, and deployment execution.  

  

  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Release Planning \& Scheduling

o Development milestones

o Pre\-production validation  

o Performance and scalability testing  

o Production deployment windows  

o Customer onboarding and certification timelines

o Product\-to\-product dependencies

o Functional testing  

o Integration testing  

o Regression testing  

o Performance testing  

o Security validation  

o Operational readiness activities

o Site Reliability Engineering teams  

o Infrastructure teams

Risk \& Issue Management  

* Identify schedule, environment, resource, and operational risks early.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Lead release war rooms for major deployments.
* Track and drive resolution of release blockers and critical dependencies.


Metrics \& Continuous Improvement  

* Define and monitor release management KPIs, including:


o Release predictability  

o On\-time delivery  

o Deployment success rate  

o Environment utilization  

o Defect leakage  

o Change failure rate

All About You

o Jenkins

o Confluence

Success Measures

* Improve release predictability and on\-time delivery.
* Reduce environment contention and resource bottlenecks.
